basis: Literal printed costs, permitted target categories, payers and destinations; target fixtures and production responses.

contracts.name: Neutralize
contracts.printedText: Neutralize a target card in the stack.
selectedClauses: Neutralize a target card in the stack.

contracts.name: Deny
contracts.printedText: Neutralize a target card on the stack unless its owner pays {H}{H}.
selectedClauses: Neutralize a target card on the stack unless its owner pays {H}{H}.

contracts.name: Ignore
contracts.printedText: Cancel a target effect on the stack unless its controller pays {H}{H}.
selectedClauses: Cancel a target effect on the stack unless its controller pays {H}{H}.

contracts.name: Veer the Will
contracts.printedText: Neutralize a target Will on the Stack. That Will returns to its owner's hand.
selectedClauses: Neutralize a target Will on the Stack. That Will returns to its owner's hand.

contracts.name: Compensate
contracts.printedText:
Neutralize a target Persistent Will on the Stack.
Its owner gains excess essence of Temperament and number equal to the Tribute cost of that card.
selectedClauses: Neutralize a target Persistent Will on the Stack.
Its owner gains excess essence of Temperament and number equal to the Tribute cost of that card.

contracts.name: Imitate
contracts.printedText: Copy a target Will on the stack. You can choose a new target for the copy.
selectedClauses: Copy a target Will on the stack. You can choose a new target for the copy.

contracts.name: Malaleuco, the Will-shaper
contracts.printedText:
As long as Malaleuco is in the Interzone, you can exhaust it to copy a Will on the stack that you control. You can choose a new target for the copy.
If Malaleuco is in hand and there is space in your Interzone, you can pay {B}{B}{B}: Put it in your Interzone.
selectedClauses: As long as Malaleuco is in the Interzone, you can exhaust it to copy a Will on the stack that you control. You can choose a new target for the copy.

contracts.name: Scrambling Beacon
contracts.printedText:
When the Scrambling Beacon enters the field, put 3 Lucore counters on it.
Pay {H}{H}{H} and remove a Lucore counter: Change the target of a target card or effect on the stack that has as target a card on the field.
selectedClauses: Pay {H}{H}{H} and remove a Lucore counter: Change the target of a target card or effect on the stack that has as target a card on the field.

contracts.name: Nullifying Radiance
contracts.printedText:
When Nullifying Radiance enters the field, put 3 Flame counters on it and choose a base temperament.
Pay {H}{H} and remove a Flame counter: Cancel a target effect on the stack of the chosen temperament controlled by an opponent that targets a card on the field you control.
selectedClauses: Pay {H}{H} and remove a Flame counter: Cancel a target effect on the stack of the chosen temperament controlled by an opponent that targets a card on the field you control.

contracts.name: Wall off
contracts.printedText: A target card on the Stack or on the field is Protected from cards and effects until the end of the turn.
selectedClauses: A target card on the Stack or on the field is Protected from cards and effects until the end of the turn.

contracts.name: Eorthoda, the Limpid
contracts.printedText: If Eorthoda is used as tribute to play a Will from your hand, that Will cannot be neutralized. If it is a Persistent Will, it additionally enters the field with Protection from cards and effects controlled by the opponents until the end of the turn.
selectedClauses: If Eorthoda is used as tribute to play a Will from your hand, that Will cannot be neutralized. If it is a Persistent Will, it additionally enters the field with Protection from cards and effects controlled by the opponents until the end of the turn.

contracts.name: Simulacrum of Clemency
contracts.printedText:
Whenever an opponent plays a Will, you gain 5 Points unless that player decides to neutralize that Will.
If a Will is neutralized this way, Exhaust Simulacrum of Clemency.
As long as Simulacrum of Clemency is Exhausted, it has no effects.
selectedClauses: Whenever an opponent plays a Will, you gain 5 Points unless that player decides to neutralize that Will.
If a Will is neutralized this way, Exhaust Simulacrum of Clemency.
As long as Simulacrum of Clemency is Exhausted, it has no effects.

contracts.name: Duel Honorably
contracts.printedText:
You may play this Will only before the Revelation.
Players cannot put manifestations into Support until the end of the turn.
A player may pay {H}{H} while this Will is on the stack to neutralize it.
selectedClauses: You may play this Will only before the Revelation.
Players cannot put manifestations into Support until the end of the turn.
A player may pay {H}{H} while this Will is on the stack to neutralize it.
